main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x excess 5-day return, before costs
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with supporting difference > 0); t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-day return, forecast > 0 minus forecast < 0 (Welch)

decided_by: The main measure's t is 2 or more and the supporting difference is above 0.
reading: The main mean pools every grid bar (positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window) with a valid 5-bar return, a zero forecast giving a zero product, the drift is each coin's mean non-overlapping 5-bar return over all its windows, and the supporting check passes on the sign of the difference alone, as the plan states.
